statements: The complete list of Scottish statutory instruments made under section 95 of the Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018 cannot be produced from the available legislation search tools, and a correct answer says so rather than presenting a partial or invented list as complete.

Section 95 of the Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018 is the ancillary provision power, letting the Scottish Ministers by regulations make incidental, supplementary, consequential, transitional, transitory or saving provision.
Instruments cannot be found by their enabling power using these tools, because the preamble reciting the powers exercised is not part of the retrievable text of an instrument.

Because section 95 is an ancillary power rather than a subject-matter power, instruments made under it share no common subject and are typically made under several powers at once, so no topic search will collect them.
